text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm summoned to the director's
office.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your input! ...Regarding a forthcoming
single is
hereby requested!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Once in a while, record
labels will
reach out to us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The idea is they partner with us to give a
top
runner in the Twinkle Series a song
of her own.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thus! We work tirelessly to find a match
between
students who put their name
down and company
preferences.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it's up to the individual
student or unit
to decide where to sing
or whether to release at
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But having a special song of one's own
can be a
source of confidence and pride.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Accordingly, we do our best to create
the best
match possible.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And guess whose turn it is this time?
That's right,
me. ☆

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But the thing is, Trainer

<username>...
We've got a
bit of a, well...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Dilemma! Truth be told, we received a
request
from the record label—it seems
there's a bit of an
issue.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, our student's potential is so
great,
they don't have a song worthy of
her!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
They're now looking to us for advice,
but, well,
this is not our specialty. I'm at
a loss for what to
say.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And that's where you come in! I've heard
of your
exploits in all things musical
lately.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What advice would you offer regarding
the
production of this new single?
Anything that
comes to mind!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hm... I see!
choice_data_list: ファルコンの気持ちを味わってもらうとか？
初心にかえりましょう！

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So, esteemed guests! This is the
racecourse used
by our students!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Please, run to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Employee A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my feet sink right into the dirt! I
didn't realize
it took this much strength
just to push off the
ground!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Employee B
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... You certainly need a lot of tenacity to run on a track like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like a grueling lap around the
track is
just what they needed to piece
together a plan
for the new single.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The basics?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Understood! I shall make the
arrangements!
choice_data_list: ライブやレースを観てもらうんです

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
...This is a fantastic concert. I didn't
realize how
much I missed seeing this.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Many thanks! I am glad I invited you
then!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
You know, this reminds me of how it all

started—with us being deeply moved by
races
and concerts long ago.

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
Hyping up a runner's debut shouldn't be
our
focus—the song should be about
drawing out the
emotions she's dealing
with for all to hear.

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm going to head back to the
office and
tell the team right away.
Please look forward to
our next
proposal.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course! Oh, before you go...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce Trainer

<username>, the
brain
behind this idea.

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so I have you to thank. I hope we'll
be hearing
more of your ideas in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the opportunity to explain the
Grand
Concert as well, and manage to
get the
company's approval and support.
choice_data_list: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします
